chip.description: Colour combiner and final mixer: background colour, three shadow/highlight blend sets, brightness and alpha-blend registers, normally driven alongside the 055555.
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k054338.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Color combiner engine / final mixer. Designed for use with the 055555"), device full name "Konami 054338 Mixer". konamiic.txt annotates it "(alpha blending)" and records the equivalent 058144 on version 2 System GX mainboards.
